timeline.text: Some days, one in four AI images just failed — blank, broken, or so wrong I had to catch it and redo by hand.
Trusting one image provider was like trusting one waiter to remember your whole order — perfect, until it wasn't.
So I built an Edge Function that races five different providers and takes whichever one actually finishes.
If the first one fails or stalls, it falls automatically to the next in line.
